name: Tickory
short_desc: Self-hosted to-do list and notes: a free Todoist alternative.
author: WNijhof
description: Tickory is a to-do list and notes app you host yourself, for you, your family or a small team. Projects, subtasks, labels, recurring tasks, quick add in plain language, list, board and calendar views, shared projects, reminders, notes, offline web app, Android app, Windows desktop app and browser extension.
